## Production deployment (READ BEFORE DEPLOYING)

- **Server:** Wharfside mini PC, hostname `vistterstream`. SSH via **Tailscale IP `100.108.181.24`** (local LAN IP 192.168.12.136 is unreachable from the dev machine). User `nickd`.
- **Branch:** `master` — server deploys by `git pull origin master`, so pushing to master IS staging a deploy.
- **Deploy:** SSH in, `cd ~/VistterStream && git pull origin master`, then
  `cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.rpi.yml --env-file ../.env up -d --build backend frontend`
  (add `--profile weather` if the tempest-weather container should run; `deploy.sh` auto-detects it).
- **WARNING: deploying restarts the backend and kills any running stream.** Check for a live stream and stop it (or get Nick's go-ahead) before deploying.
- **Alembic:** new migrations need `docker exec vistterstream-backend alembic upgrade head`. `create_tables()` does NOT add columns to existing tables.
- **Must use `--env-file .env`** — JWT_SECRET_KEY and ENCRYPTION_KEY are required; secrets live in `.env` at repo root (never commit) and in Apple Passwords.
- **Cannot run the full stack locally on the Mac** — needs the `/data` volume and Docker environment. Local `venv/`/`backend/.venv` are for IDE/linting and running the pytest suite only.

## Key facts

- Backend FastAPI + SQLite (`/data/vistterstream.db`), frontend React (Tailwind JIT), FFmpeg with Intel VA-API hardware encode (`h264_vaapi`).
- Streams to YouTube via per-destination OAuth — account **vistter2@gmail.com**, public URL `stream.vistter.com` (Cloudflare tunnel). Account/channel routing rules: `~/Workspaces/wiki/spine/infrastructure/accounts-and-logins.md`.
- **ShortForge** (per-preset clip capture → Ken Burns shorts) is the active short-form pipeline; ReelForge is deprecated but still in the repo.
- Cameras: Sunba PTZ at 192.168.12.59 (ONVIF 8899); Reolink disabled. PTZ presets drive timeline cues and ShortForge capture.
- Tests: `pytest` in `backend/` (100+ tests); CI runs backend pytest + frontend build on GitHub Actions.
- Deep operational history (incidents, security hardening, FFmpeg fixes): memory file `vistterstream.md` in the AgentArchitect project memory — treat as point-in-time notes, verify against code.

## Parallel Agent Git Rules (CRITICAL)

- **ONLY commit files YOU changed in THIS session** — always `git add <specific-paths>`, NEVER `git add -A` or `git add .` (repo carries deliberately-untracked uploads, venvs, and working assets)
- NEVER: `git reset --hard`, `git checkout .` / `git restore .`, `git clean -fd`, `git stash`, `git commit --no-verify`, force-push to master
